narr: Thunderstorms developed during the afternoon and evening hours as a low pressure system moved through a warm and humid airmass that was in place across the Ohio Valley.
ev: Several roads were flooded in Sugar Creek Township. Engle Mill, Cornstalk, and Cook Roads all had washouts and were impassable.
Flash flooding was reported along Lower Hillside Drive.
Vehicles became stuck in rising water on Roxanna New Burlington Road.
A culvert was washed on on U.S. Route 62 near Northview Drive.
High water resulted in the closure of numerous roads across Warren County, including Columbia Road between U.S. Route 42 and Glosser Road.
About a foot of water was rapidly flowing across State Route 73.
